summary: Frustrated: fix live but fob re-add still blocked
detailed_context: Nick reports he cancelled the fob request and separately cancelled the programming, both done, yet re-adding the fob remains blocked. The previous response declared v1.23.1 live and the Add Credential stage fix verified, so Nick's real-world flow still fails after a claimed success. The 'still blocked' phrasing signals a major miss on a task he considered complete, without an angry tone. Lesson: verify the end-to-end user path (the re-add flow itself, not just the deploy/health check) before declaring a fix done, and ask what error or state the block shows rather than assuming the deploy resolved it.
